messages:
elaine: Heads-up  competitor launched tenant-level fallback routing today. Getting questions from pilots. Parity or different angle? :thinking:

sam: Their fallback = route to smaller model under load. Cheap but quality drops on long-context chats.

anya: I can run quick evals across three tenant archetypes to measure quality impact. 3-5 days.

divya: Sales: pilots asking for cost predictability during spikes. If we lack an option, RFQs will call it out.

mike: Product idea: configurable fallback policies (latency, cost, quality-preserve). Gives parity + differentiation.

tara: Telemetry: ~8% requests in burst profile are safe candidates for fallback. Need regression curves.

elaine: Proposed play: 1) 1-week eval spike (anya+tara); 2) prototype policy toggle in routing (sam+mike) gated to Dedicated; 3) define launch gates.

sam: Prototype plan: feature flag `route.fallback_policy` with values {latency,cost,quality}. Estimate 2 engs x 2 sprints for a minimal canary-scaffold.

anya: I'll produce prompt sets and baselines. ETA 5 working days.

divya: Gate to Dedicated/Private for beta so ops risk is limited and sales can offer it as enterprise control. I can line up pilots if we commit to ~6-week beta.

mike: UX: per-tenant toggle + API override. I'll mock a quick console flow and API in 48h.

ops-bot: deploy reminder: canary cluster upgrade scheduled 2024-06-07T03:00Z.

elaine: Draft v0 launch criteria: quality regression <3% weighted, p95 latency improvement >15% in cost mode, tenant controls in console/API, canary + 15m rollback, docs + sales one-pager.

tara: Add telemetry: rolling 30m quality-drift alert and auto-rollback if >5% regression for top tenants.

sam: Risk: multi-variant models complicate KV cache priming/invalidation. Expect +10% ops effort.

elaine: Ask: short cross-functional spike this sprint, decision at PRD sync. If green, roadmap add = 2 eng sprints + 1 UX sprint + evals.

divya: :thumbsup: prepping pilot list.

anya: Starting evals today; will post results here by EOD Friday.

sam: I'll assign an engineer to pair with mike next sprint for the scaffold.

mike: Posting figma mock and mini-API spec in 48h.

elaine: Goal for PRD sync: metric-backed recommendation (parity shim vs policy-led product), dev estimate, go/no-go for Dedicated beta.

ops-bot: reminder: PRD sync 2024-06-10 16:00 UTC.

elaine: Thanks  will synthesize into a short PRD and link to the sync.
